accepted_diagnosis.summary: The current blocker is a latent incomplete Repair #4 database migration. Production already contains the repair_attempt_lineage_sha256 column but retains legacy single-column uniqueness constraints, because _migrate_repair_attempt_lineage() returns early when the column exists. The final Repair #4 implementation (d1b7a04) added composite-constraint rescoping only after a superseded image (3065292651) had already created the column. Schema state is therefore partially migrated: repair_attempt_lineage_sha256 column = present; uq_m67_coordinator_release = legacy single-column UNIQUE(authorization_release_id); uq_m67_coordinator_work_item = presumed legacy single-column (to be independently verified and converged regardless). This causes a legitimate second deterministic repair-attempt coordinator for the same experiment/release lineage (Repair #5 resume, authorized release 375a88da-da88-5ebf-9daf-cb09934e02b8) to fail with UniqueViolation on uq_m67_coordinator_release, pre-M1, with zero target transport.
